name: Blue Zushi
summary: **Blue Zushi** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] from [[breeder:The TENco]], crossing [[zkittlez|Zkittlez]] and a numbered [[kush-mints|Kush Mints]] phenotype known as Kush Mints #11. It circulated among legacy growers before wider release.
